title: Microsoft Ads Cost in 2026: Bing Ads Pricing and Budget - Aimers Blog

facts.fact: Microsoft Ads does not have a fixed price or a required minimum spend for search campaigns.
facts.quote: Microsoft Ads does not have a fixed price or a required minimum spend.

facts.fact: Microsoft says advertisers can get 19% lower CPCs than a leading ad platform, citing an eMarketer Q1 2026 forecast (vendor claim, platform-level comparison).
facts.quote: Microsoft says advertisers can get 19% lower CPCs and 6% higher CTRs

facts.fact: Microsoft says advertisers can get 6% higher CTRs than a leading ad platform, citing an eMarketer Q1 2026 forecast (vendor claim, platform-level comparison).
facts.quote: Microsoft says advertisers can get 19% lower CPCs and 6% higher CTRs

facts.fact: A 2025 third-party agency benchmark (QueryClick) placed average Microsoft Ads CPC around $1.50-$2.80; Microsoft does not present this as a guaranteed platform average.
facts.quote: A 2025 agency benchmark placed average Microsoft Ads CPC around $1.50-$2.80

facts.fact: Microsoft's automated bidding guidance recommends at least 30 conversions in the previous 30 days before evaluating Target CPA or Maximize Conversions.
facts.quote: recommends at least 30 conversions in the previous 30 days before evaluation

facts.fact: Microsoft's automated bidding guidance is followed by a one- to two-week learning period.
facts.quote: followed by a one- to two-week learning period

facts.fact: In Aimers' example for initial keyword validation, an expected $3 CPC times 100 clicks equals $300.
In Aimers' example for a search conversion pilot, an expected $5 CPC times 200 clicks equals $1,000.
In Aimers' example for target CPA planning, a $150 target CPA times 30 required conversions equals $4,500.

Aimers generally recommends around $3,000 per month per platform as a practical starting point for meaningful SaaS and tech testing; this is an agency planning recommendation, not a Microsoft minimum.
facts.quote: That is an agency planning recommendation, not a Microsoft minimum.

facts.fact: Microsoft Ads search ads can appear on Bing and Microsoft search partners, which may include Yahoo, AOL, DuckDuckGo, and Ecosia.
facts.quote: which may include Yahoo, AOL, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, and other partner inventory

facts.fact: Bing Ads was renamed Microsoft Advertising.
facts.quote: Bing Ads was renamed Microsoft Advertising.

facts.fact: The Aimers article is dated September 14, 2026.
